title: Amazon Product Scraper
description: Scrape Amazon product details from a search term or a list of product URLs. Results are pushed to the run's dataset as JSON records.

searchTerm.title: Search term
searchTerm.description: Amazon search query. Each search result is opened and scraped individually. Leave empty to scrape URLs directly.

productUrls.title: Product URLs
productUrls.description: List of Amazon product URLs to scrape (e.g. https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0ABC123XY). Ignored when a search term is provided.

domain.title: Amazon domain
domain.description: Marketplace to scrape. When product URLs are given, the domain is auto-detected from them.

maxResults.title: Maximum products
maxResults.description: Maximum number of search results to scrape.

maxPages.title: Maximum search pages
maxPages.description: Maximum number of search result pages to walk before collecting products.

maxReviews.title: Maximum reviews per product
maxReviews.description: Maximum number of customer reviews to scrape for each product. 0 disables review scraping.

zip.title: Delivery ZIP / postal code
zip.description: Delivery location used for price and availability (only applied on amazon.com).

proxy.title: Proxy configuration
proxy.description: Apify proxy (recommended) or custom proxy URLs. Required for stable scraping at scale.

session.title: Proxy session ID
session.description: Optional sticky-IP session ID. When empty, the proxy rotates automatically. Use a fixed ID to keep one IP for the whole run.

retries.title: Retries
retries.description: Attempts per product before giving up.

timeout.title: Navigation timeout
timeout.description: Timeout for a single page load.

wait.title: Wait after page load
wait.description: Extra pause after each page loads, before extracting data.

freshRun.title: Ignore previous run state
freshRun.description: Start from scratch instead of resuming URLs already scraped by an interrupted run.
